newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 3.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Henri Konan Bedie opens Ivory Coast's Market for African Performing Arts (MASA 97).

- U.N. World Food Programme says in advertisment it is preparing to call tenders for supply of 200 tonnes of maize flour produced locally; invites interested bidders to obtain tender documents from its Abidjan offices: B P 1747 Abidjan 01, not later than March 8, 1997.
- Teachers union serves notice of examinations boycott at end of this academic year if government fails to meet demands for improved conditions.
